scope: NPC greetings, interaction prompts and world-event announcements, plus the user-requested replacement of bandit Flee with a fixed 500 ryo toll.
method: Read greetings and prompts in their interaction context; trace callbacks, server settlement and event triggers; retain established lore and simplify instructions; regenerate authored story assets.

greetings: Story field points and story road encounters
announcements: Weekly Boss spawn and automatic settlement
Clan Boss spawn, sector pressure and weekly settlement
Legacy awakening, Binding and Stage V completion

factualFindings.finding: The user requested a real toll instead of the bandit Flee option.
factualFindings.implementation: Natural bandits offer Fight or Pay 500 ryo. The server resolves the current bandit, deducts carried ryo only, and commits the receipt with the wallet change and existing wanderer cooldown/relocation. Payment costs no HP. Insufficient funds leave the encounter open. Lost replies can be retried without a second charge. Other hostile types retain their existing choices; existing peace/truce behavior still applies.

factualFindings.finding: Fishing has no shade, weather or dusk catch bonuses. Nodes require Fishing skill and a usable pole.
Memory counts identify archetypes, not personal acquaintance with the specific NPC.
The medic restores HP, chakra and stamina; the merchant immediately exchanges ryo for bone charms.
Weekly Boss rewards are delivered automatically after expiry, with rank-specific Core and Key rewards and once-per-week limits. The World Bosses hub contains the Weekly tab.
Clan Boss weekly settlement and the next spawn are separate steps. Sector threat percentages are not the boss HP percentage.
World crisis alarms trigger at levels 37 and 80. The second crisis offers shinobi Collection Cell fights or three-companion pursuit-pack battles.
Story field greetings retain authored objects and events. The unclear mapped-lee greeting still describes the mapped shelter and waxed pages found in daylight.
The rival miner fight is optional and does not unlock gathering at the node.

focused.coverage: Toll settlement, exact price, HP preservation, replay, failed writes, receipt ownership, fishing guidance and client request behavior.
Both world-crisis authorities and Legacy trial announcement behavior.
Save ownership mirrors, map/dialogue projection constraints and asset fixture lifecycle.

browser.coverage: Bandit Fight/Pay choice, payment request and response, insufficient funds, opaque dialogue backing, merchant/medic/tracker prompts.

integrationCorrections: Synchronized the client protected-save field mirror with the new server-owned toll receipt.

Grouped asynchronous Azure asset fixture preparation under a parent test suite so cleanup cannot delete a fixture still being prepared.

revisions.after: ${player} reached level 80 and triggered the public alarm. Village record keepers opened four regional reports already filed by Kite Harrow.
